newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise October rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise October rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Wednesday that it would raise the margin requirement on its October rubber futures contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Thursday.
The increase will bring the total margin requirement on the October contract to 157,750 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The increases are intended to cool overheated trade.
The margin fee on the November contract will be unchanged at 62,500 yen, while fees on other contracts will still be 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
